sentence: This project builds a regional network that connects research and industry to grow laser and photonics technologies and their manufacturing.
This project uses a telescope to observe active galactic nuclei and to take high-speed images of exoplanet candidates.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that pick out cell nuclei in microscope images to help detect cancer early.
This project plans a center that uses artificial intelligence and data from sensors and cameras to improve manufacturing.
This project measures forms of carbon and hydrogen in methane trapped in ancient Antarctic ice to learn why methane levels changed in the past.
This project studies how genes from genetically engineered crops attach to microplastics and how they move and last in the environment.
This project builds interactive visual tools that let researchers guide artificial intelligence as they analyze human tissue scans.
This project designs ways to fix errors in quantum computing hardware that stores information in superconducting oscillators by using patterns in the noise.
This project builds computer tools that combine gene activity maps from many tissue sections to rebuild the three-dimensional shape of tissue.
This project builds protections that keep machine learning models and private data safe when researchers share them through an online service.
This project holds a conference on environmental engineering topics such as water, critical minerals and quantum sensing.
This project covers ocean and coastal science topics such as oceanography, marine biology, marine geology and ocean engineering.
This project develops methods to tell how uncertain estimates are when they come from incomplete and noisy measurements.
This project builds a framework that lets edge devices generate synthetic network traffic data while protecting user privacy.
This project creates course materials that teach computer science by having learners program drones to protect privacy and improve security.
